task.title: Rescinding the disentitlement — Claim in MPS

step.cmd: In NWS, create a ROD as follows:

ul.li: Comments: Type “Out of Canada — 13 - Outside Canada disentitlement rescinded.”
Details: Type “The client cancelled the absence from Canada. The 13 - Outside Canada disentitlement has been rescinded.”

step.cmd: Determine if a D3 was also imposed for the out of Canada issue:

ul.li: If no, go to step 3.

If yes, create another ROD as follows:
Comments: Type “Availability — 3 - Not available disentitlement rescinded.”
Details: Type “The client cancelled the absence from Canada. The 3 - Not available disentitlement has been rescinded.”

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 93 - Manual Pay System .
Work type: Select 30 - New information on a manual pay claim .
Remarks line 1: Type “[Disentitlement information and dates] — rescind.”
Remarks line 2: If required, type other information or changes needed (including claimant’s reports, if necessary)
Remarks line 4: Type your name and telephone number.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 04 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the WI for the out of Canada issue.
